excerpts.content:
The following type doesn't enforce any additional constraints and `ProgressiveList[AttesterSlashing]` looks unambiguous:
```python
class AttesterSlashings(ProgressiveList[AttesterSlashing]):
    """
    The attester slashings included in a beacon block.
    """
```
What is the purpose of introducing a new type? cc <@881905303011086387>
